components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; padding: 15px 21px; background: #101112; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 100px; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s, background-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #246bfd; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #246bfd; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Ghost Button

components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; padding: 15px 21px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); color: #101112; border: 1px solid rgba(16,17,18,0.12); border-radius: 100px; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s, background-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #ffffff; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #246bfd; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.description: Floating pill-shaped glass bar centered in the sticky header.
components.html: PlatformSolutionsCompany
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0; padding: 6px 8px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.9); border-radius: 100px; box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(39,47,54,0.07); } .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 64px; padding: 6px 7px; color: #4f555a; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.18s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #101112; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #246bfd; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.css: .ds-card { padding: 26px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.9); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(39,53,62,0.08); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px); font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; max-width: 320px; } .ds-card-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 46px; height: 46px; margin-bottom: 38px; background: #101112; color: #ffffff; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-card-label { display: block; color: #246bfd; font-size: 0.51rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.11em; } .ds-card-title { margin: 14px 0 10px; font-size: 1.22rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.04em; color: #101112; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; color: #676d72; font-size: 0.72rem; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Form Field
components.description: Boxless, underline-only text field with an uppercase muted label — the system's one exception to its rounded shape language.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { color: #676d72; font-size: 0.62rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field-input { padding: 8px 2px; background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(16,17,18,0.12); color: #101112; font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.85rem; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: #9aa0a5; } .ds-field-input:focus { border-color: #101112; outline: none; }

components.name: Tab Switch
components.description: Segmented pill control for switching between sample captures.
components.css: .ds-tabswitch { display: flex; width: fit-content; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; background: #eef0f2; border-radius: 999px; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-tab { padding: 9px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: none; color: #676d72; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #101112; } .ds-tab.is-active { background: #101112; color: #ffffff; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #246bfd; outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
Scanity's interface reads like its own product output: solid, near-black forms standing in for structure, and soft translucent glass standing in for the reconstructed space around them. The mood is precise and understated — the interface stays quiet so the 3D capture itself is always the most interesting thing on the page. Deep Ink carries almost all of the weight (text, fills, icon badges); Scan Blue appears rarely and only where something is happening or actionable (a hover, a link, the scan beam sweeping across the hero visual). Nothing shouts; hierarchy is built with scale and generous whitespace, not color or noise.

A barely-perceptible film-grain texture (1.8% opacity fractal noise) sits fixed over the entire page, keeping the large flat cloud-grey and white surfaces from feeling sterile or purely digital. Type is set entirely in Manrope, one family carrying every role from the 7rem hero display down to 0.5rem uppercase labels, differentiated by weight and tracking rather than by font-pairing.
keyCharacteristics: One typeface (Manrope), one accent color (Scan Blue), used sparingly against a dominant Deep Ink / white / cloud-grey neutral field.
A simulated point-cloud scan scene as the hero's signature visual, not a static photo or illustration.
Pill-shaped buttons and navigation throughout, contrasted with completely boxless, underline-only form fields.
Large asymmetric section headers (a narrow kicker column beside a wide heading) opening most major sections.
A subtle full-page grain overlay as the only textural decoration.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Scan Blue is reserved for hover states, the focus ring, and the few live/animated elements (scan beam, status dot, workflow orb). It never fills a large surface or competes with Deep Ink for dominance.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Every text role — from the 7.4rem hero headline to a 0.5rem form caption — is Manrope. Hierarchy is built entirely through size, weight, tracking, and color, never a second typeface.

dos: Do keep Scan Blue rare — hover states, the focus ring, and live/animated elements only (see The One Accent Rule).
Do pair every icon with a full-circle Deep Ink badge when introducing a card, step, or list row.
Do keep buttons pill-shaped and compact; there is no large, heavy CTA anywhere in the system.
Do open major sections with the asymmetric kicker + heading header pattern.
Do keep form fields boxless and underline-only; this is the deliberate exception to the system's rounded shape language, not an oversight.
donts: Don't add customer logos or named case studies to the trust strip. Per PRODUCT.md, Scanity is pre-launch with no real clients yet — the strip must stay industry-label-only until real evidence exists.
Don't introduce a second typeface. Every role, from the largest display heading to the smallest label, stays in Manrope.

Don't remove the hero's "Sample data" pill or give the illustrative stats ("12.4M points", "98.6% processed") the unqualified visual weight of verified data elsewhere in the product — they are UI-mockup values, not real captured metrics (see PRODUCT.md → Evidence on Hand).
Don't add hard-edged or sharply-defined shadows; every elevated surface in the current system uses a large, soft, low-opacity shadow.
